name: PURIST OPEN: Great Lakes Unaugmented Athletics
description: The Purist Open is the largest sanctioned zero-augmentation multi-sport competition in the Great Lakes corridor, governed by the Clean Body Athletic Commission — an independent body funded by small Tier 3 civic associations and a handful of ideologically motivated Tier 4 donors. Athletes submit to full-spectrum BCI suppression, geneware audits, and subdermal scanning before every event, competing in track, field, swimming, and contact disciplines with unmodified bodies. The event is simultaneously celebrated as a monument to baseline humanity and mocked by augmented sports media as 'watching people fall down slowly.'
story_hooks: A the Gray Zone-born runner qualifies for the Open through a community program and discovers that the 'ideologically pure' wealthy patrons funding the event have been quietly lobbying to introduce income-based entry restrictions.
An athlete who has secretly carried dormant heritable geneware her entire life — unknown to her — faces disqualification and public humiliation just before the final event of her career.
A corporate spy embedded in the Clean Body Athletic Commission is tasked with finding a way to discredit the Open so a rival augmented league can absorb its broadcast slot.
